falsification_conditions.condition: VIX closes above 35 for 3 consecutive trading days
falsification_conditions.what_it_would_mean: The bottom_2024_aug pattern assumed a volatility compression and gradual recovery; sustained VIX >35 indicates panic selling and capitulation not present in the original pattern, invalidating the structural similarity

falsification_conditions.condition: 10Y-2Y Treasury yield curve inverts by more than -50 basis points
falsification_conditions.what_it_would_mean: The original bottom_2024_aug occurred during curve steepening; deepening inversion signals recession acceleration and Fed policy trap, breaking the macro regime match

falsification_conditions.condition: S&P 500 closes below 4,200 on any single day
falsification_conditions.what_it_would_mean: The August 2024 bottom held at ~4,400; a break below 4,200 would exceed the pattern's drawdown magnitude by >15%, proving this is not the same structural bottom and the 78% similarity was noise

doctrine: If you can't list what would prove your call wrong, you don't have a real call.
